*[[Siege of Coruscant]]<ref name="TLC">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref>
*[[Death/Legends|Death]] of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]<ref name="TLC" />}}
{{Quote|History is on the move, Captain. Those who cannot keep up will be left behind, to watch from a distance. And those who stand in our way will not watch at all.|Grand Admiral Thrawn to Captain Gilad Pellaeon|<ref name="TLC" />}}
The following events took place in '''9 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[Bureau of Ships and Services/Legends|BoSS]] case on the [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']]{{'s}} [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|destruction]] was officially closed, and the Imperial report exposed as a complete fabrication.<ref name="SWI90:RR">{{InsiderCite|90|Refresher Reading}}</ref>
*The [[Thrawn campaign]] began and ended.<ref name="TEA" />
**[[Nomad City]] was [[Raid on Nomad City|raided]]<ref name="HttE" /> and [[Destruction of Nomad City|destroyed]] by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]].<ref name="DFR">''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref><ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
**Thrawn recovered the long lost [[Katana fleet|''Katana'' fleet]].<ref name="DFR" /><ref name="TEA" />
**Grand Admiral Thrawn conducted a hit and fade [[Siege of Coruscant|attack]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], successfully seeding the [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] with [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaked]] [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]].<ref name="TLC" /><ref name="TEA" />
**Creation of the [[Smugglers' Alliance]].<ref name="TLC" />
**The [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] joined the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="TLC" />
**The [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|Mount Tantiss]] [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] facility of [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]] was [[Assault on Mount Tantiss|destroyed]].<ref name="TLC" />
**[[Death/Legends|Death]] of Thrawn.<ref name="TLC" /><ref name="TEA" />
**The [[Empire of the Hand]] began to wait for Thrawn's return.<ref name="VotF">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref>
**Fall of [[Thrawn's confederation]].<ref name="TEA" />
*[[Hegemony theater]]: [[Prince-Admiral/Legends|Prince-Admiral]] [[Delak Krennel]] was defeated by the New Republic.<ref name="IR">''[[X-Wing: Isard's Revenge]]''</ref>
*The [[Obroan]]s of [[Obroa-skai/Legends|Obroa-skai]] kept their planet neutral during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], despite heavy petitioning by the New Republic.
*[[Bestine IV/Legends|Bestine IV]] joined the New Republic.<ref name="TEA" />
